answer.text: Gives the issuer the right to redeem before maturity at a specified price

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 59 says a callable bond gives the issuer the right to redeem outstanding bonds before specified maturity and creates reinvestment risk for investors; page 69 supports the prescribed-price phrasing. The Trap: The other options misdescribe the call feature. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A pages 59 and 69.
